methodology_meta_description: PickItWell's public, verifiable methodology: Gold (0 additives), Silver (1–2 additives), Bronze (3–4 additives), and exclusion of products with 5+ additives.
methodology_subtitle: The single, public, verifiable criterion used to classify packaged grocery products.
methodology_companion_desc: Learn about the limits of the information presented and terms of use.
methodology_s1_body: This document publicly and verifiably describes the single criterion by which PickItWell classifies packaged food products. Its goal is to ensure transparency and identical application of the same rule to every product, regardless of brand, manufacturer, or store.
methodology_s2_body: PickItWell classifies products solely based on the number of food additives declared on the product label (ingredients with an E-code or an equivalent name explicitly declared as an additive by the producer on the packaging). Nutritional value, sugar/salt/fat content, degree of processing, ingredient origin, price, and brand reputation are not considered. The methodology counts rather than interprets.
methodology_s3_body: An additive is any ingredient appearing on the product label as an E-code (e.g., E330) or under its equivalent name declared as an additive (e.g., "citric acid" listed separately from base ingredients). All additives are counted equally, regardless of type, function, or origin (preservative, colorant, sweetener, stabilizer, etc.). PickItWell does not distinguish between "better" or "worse" additives — each declared additive counts as one unit.
methodology_table_caption: PickItWell classification tiers by number of declared additives
methodology_s4_callout: Products with 5 or more declared additives are not included in the PickItWell catalog.
methodology_s5_body: Information is taken directly from the product label, photographed or physically examined by the PickItWell team at the point of sale, or, when the physical label is unavailable, from information officially published by the manufacturer or retailer (the official product or store website). Every product displays the date of its last verification.
methodology_s6_body_prefix: Products are re-verified periodically, and any report from a user or producer regarding a possible recipe change triggers a priority re-verification (see
methodology_s6_body_suffix: ). PickItWell does not guarantee a fixed re-verification cadence for every individual product given the size of retail catalogs and how frequently manufacturers reformulate recipes.
methodology_s7_title: What this methodology does NOT cover
methodology_s7_ex1: a food safety evaluation of the product;
methodology_s7_ex2: a nutritional evaluation or degree-of-processing assessment;
methodology_s7_ex4: a claim regarding the overall quality of the product.
methodology_s7_outro: A product classified as Gold (0 additives) may still contain high amounts of sugar, salt, or fat — aspects not evaluated by this methodology. Classification refers strictly to the number of declared additives.
methodology_s8_body_prefix: Any producer, retailer, or user who identifies a verification error (e.g., reformulated recipe, misread label, outdated product) may request re-verification through our
methodology_s8_body_suffix: . PickItWell commits to reviewing the report and, if confirmed, updating the product's classification within {days} business days of receiving the notice, along with the new verification date.
methodology_s9_body: A product's classification cannot be altered for payment and is not influenced by commercial partnerships, sponsorships, or advertising. A brand may partner with PickItWell only if its products already meet higher tier criteria under this methodology, applied identically to every non-partnered product.
methodology_s10_body: PickItWell reserves the right to update this methodology to reflect improvements to the verification process. Any update will be published on this page with its effective date, and existing classifications will be re-evaluated against the updated criteria within a reasonable timeframe.
disclaimer_meta_title: PickItWell Disclaimer — Nature of Information & Limitation of Liability
disclaimer_meta_description: PickItWell legal disclaimer: strictly informational classification, data accuracy, store availability, and limitation of liability.
disclaimer_subtitle: Information about the strictly informational nature of the app, data accuracy, and limitation of liability.
disclaimer_companion_desc: See the single criterion used to classify products into Gold, Silver, and Bronze.
disclaimer_s1_body: PickItWell is an informational tool that counts and displays the number of food additives declared on a product label as shown on the packaging or in public sources consulted on the verification date. PickItWell does not perform laboratory analyses, chemical tests, nutritional evaluations, or food safety assessments for any product. The Gold/Silver/Bronze classification reflects solely the number of declared additives, not a judgment on quality, safety, nutritional value, or processing level.
disclaimer_s2_body: Information in PickItWell is strictly informational. PickItWell does not recommend, discourage, or instruct users to buy or avoid any specific product. The purchasing decision belongs exclusively to the user. Any interpretation of the classification as "buying advice", a "safety warning", or a "medical recommendation" is solely the user's own and goes beyond the stated purpose of the app.
disclaimer_s3_title: No medical, nutritional, or professional advice
disclaimer_s3_body: PickItWell content does not constitute and does not replace medical, nutritional, dietary, or other professional advice. For decisions involving allergies, intolerances, medical conditions, or specific dietary regimens, users must consult a physician, nutritionist, or other qualified specialist, as well as the original product label.
disclaimer_s4_title: Accuracy, timeliness, and limits of information
disclaimer_s4_body: Information is manually verified by the PickItWell team on the date indicated on each product ("Label checked on..."). Recipes, packaging, and product composition may change without notice from the manufacturer, and PickItWell cannot guarantee that displayed details match the packaging currently on store shelves at all times. Users must personally check the physical product label before purchase or consumption, regardless of what appears in the app. PickItWell makes no express or implied warranty regarding accuracy, completeness, or timeliness.
disclaimer_s5_body: References to stores where a product "was spotted" reflect a point-in-time observation on the verification date and do not constitute a guarantee of stock, price, or current availability. PickItWell has no contractual relationship with the listed stores and does not verify real-time inventory.
disclaimer_s6_body_prefix: PickItWell does not aim to disparage, defame, or cast any manufacturer or brand in a negative light. Product classification relies on a single, objective criterion applied identically to all products: the number of additives declared on the label, per the
disclaimer_s6_body_mid: . Any producer who spots a verification error regarding their product may request a correction via our
disclaimer_s6_body_suffix: , and PickItWell will re-verify the information within a reasonable timeframe.
disclaimer_s7_body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, PickItWell, its operators, and affiliates shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use information presented in the app, including without limitation purchasing decisions, allergic reactions, health effects, or financial losses.
disclaimer_s8_body: Product names, logos, and trademarks mentioned belong to their respective owners and are used solely for identification and informational purposes, without any implied affiliation, sponsorship, or endorsement, except for partnerships explicitly declared in the app.
disclaimer_s9_body: By using PickItWell, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted this disclaimer, and that any decision made based on the information presented is yours alone.
